set.body:
The invariant that justifies splitting control from compute: for fixed
statistical specs, varying compute_spec() (strategy, fast_path, parallel, nchunks)
must produce identical betas, standard errors, and p-values to tolerance.

This is currently violated by design. tests/testthat/test_fast_slow_parity.R:4-7
documents in its header that AR p-values differ between engines and are
deliberately never compared - so AR p-value calibration is untested on both paths.

Under the new split that is a bug, not a design choice, and this gate says so.
Expect it to fail when first written; that failure is the point.
set.title: Test gate: compute options must not change results
